edit.description: Add `pub fn builtin_floor(kind: &str) -> temper::contract::Contract` beside `fresh_clause` (:1073, the existing "read the shipped default off the embedded lock" family): `temper::builtin::contract(kind)` resolved the way the shipped `check` resolves it, panicking by kind name on a missing floor. The body is the generalized one `lock_declaration_rows.rs:2401` already writes inline (`unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("built-in kind `{kind}` ships an embedded floor"))`), so this is "generalize a near-duplicate", not "add new".

Delete `builtin_skill_contract` (:35) and reach `common::builtin_floor("skill")` at its two call sites (:74, :109). `Contract` is named only by the deleted signature, so `use temper::contract::Contract;` (:27) goes with it — clippy runs at `-D warnings`.

Delete `skill_builtin` (:28) — the byte-identical twin of acceptance.rs's helper, the two bodies the census compared — and reach the shared one at :167, :178, :198. `Contract` stays imported: `predicate_vector` (:34) takes `&Contract`.

Delete `rule_builtin` (:25) — the same job at kind `rule`, the near-duplicate the generalization subsumes — and reach `common::builtin_floor("rule")` at :79, :97, :116, :149, :164, :278. Drop `Contract` from the braced import (:17); nothing else in the file names it.

Point `floor_quads` (:2401) at the helper whose body it already spells, and the inline `builtin::contract("skill").expect(…)` at :2796 with it. Those are the file's only two code uses of `builtin`, so `use temper::builtin;` (:20) is stranded; the module-doc prose at :2385/:2388/:2793 names `builtin::contract` and rides this entry (backticked prose, not an intra-doc link).
`covered_rules` (:201) spells the same lookup inline for `plugin-manifest`; reach `common::builtin_floor("plugin-manifest")` instead. This file has no `use crate::common` yet — add it.

Six inline spellings of one lookup in one file — `builtin::contract("agent")` at :154 (with an `expect` message) and :195, :211, :232, :278, :324 (bare `.unwrap()`): reach the helper at all six. `use temper::builtin;` (:18) is then unused (`builtin_kind` is a separate import); the module doc's `builtin::contract` cite at :8 rides this entry.

summary: One job — resolve a built-in kind's embedded floor or panic — is spelled five ways across six test suites; fold them onto one `common::builtin_floor(kind)`.

tests.asserts: the skill floor's decidable clause vector, per-clause guidance and cite pins pass unchanged reading the floor through the shared helper
the rule floor's clause-vector, admissibility and validate pins pass unchanged through the shared helper
the broken-rules diagnostics snapshot and the clean-skill round trip are byte-unchanged
`floor_quads` and the skill guidance/cite round-trip read every floor through the one helper

acceptance: `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` green, with `rg 'builtin::contract\(' tests/` answering `tests/it/common/mod.rs` alone — no per-suite wrapper and no inline floor lookup survives.
